# taskbox

An offline Python task service. Call src.app.execute(command, **params).
Commands: add(title=...), list(). Lists return every task in insertion order.
Task records have id, title, and completed (initially False).

Layering: app dispatches commands; service validates input; repository owns
in-memory task storage. Settings belong in src/config.py. There is no UI,
network, database, authentication, or deployment pipeline.

Run the real behavior tests with `make test` (Python standard library only).

# Agent guide — taskbox

- Layering is a rule, not a habit: `src/app.py` only dispatches, `src/service.py`
  validates input, `src/repository.py` owns storage.
- Gate: run `make test` before every commit. Never commit red.
- Commits use Conventional Commits (`feat: ...`, `fix: ...`, `test: ...`).
- One feature, one PR: code, tests, and docs ship together. Never move tests
  into a follow-up PR.
- New work starts in a git worktree under `.worktrees/` (gitignored), on a new
  branch from `main`. Work on an existing feature branch continues in place.
  Plan documents a user asks for are saved where the user says.
- There is no remote. The terminal state is a committed branch; never commit
  to `main`.

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Offline stand-in for the herdr CLI. Logs every call beside the common git
# directory (so calls made from a linked worktree land in the same log) and
# answers with predictable ids: the caller lives in the pane named by
# .git/herdr-self (default w1:p1, the super manager), an unrelated team in w2,
# and the workspaces this shim creates are w7, w8, … in order. A tab or a
# split lands in the workspace its --workspace or --pane names.
gitdir="$(git rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-common-dir 2>/dev/null || echo .)"
log="$gitdir/herdr-calls.log"
self="$(cat "$gitdir/herdr-self" 2>/dev/null || echo w1:p1)"
# Value of "--name VALUE" or "--name=VALUE" among the arguments.
arg() {
  local name="$1"; shift
  while [ $# -gt 0 ]; do
    case "$1" in
      "$name") echo "$2"; return ;;
      "$name"=*) echo "${1#*=}"; return ;;
    esac
    shift
  done
}
# Reject the two forms the real CLI rejects, and keep them out of the graded log.
usage=""
case "$1 $2" in
  "pane split") case " $* " in *" --direction "*) ;; *)
    usage="usage: herdr pane split [<pane_id>|--pane ID|--current] --direction right|down [--cwd PATH] [--focus|--no-focus]" ;; esac ;;
  "pane move") case " $* " in *" --new-tab "*|*" --new-workspace "*|*" --tab "*) ;; *)
    usage="usage: herdr pane move <pane_id> --tab <tab_id> --split right|down | --new-tab [--workspace ID] | --new-workspace [--label TEXT]" ;; esac ;;
esac
if [ -n "$usage" ]; then echo "rejected: herdr $*" >> "$log"; echo "$usage" >&2; exit 2; fi
echo "herdr $*" >> "$log"
created=$(grep -c '^herdr workspace create' "$log")
panes=$(grep -Ec '^herdr (pane split|tab create)' "$log")
tabs=$(grep -c '^herdr tab create' "$log")
case "$1 $2" in
  "workspace create")
    ws="w$((6 + created))"
    echo '{"id":"cli:workspace:create","result":{"workspace":{"workspace_id":"'"$ws"'","label":"team"},"tab":{"tab_id":"'"$ws"':t1"},"root_pane":{"pane_id":"'"$ws"':p1"}}}' ;;
  "workspace list")
    extra=""
    n=1
    while [ "$n" -le "$created" ]; do
      extra="$extra"',{"workspace_id":"w'"$((6 + n))"'","label":"team","focused":false,"pane_count":1}'
      n=$((n + 1))
    done
    echo '{"id":"cli:workspace:list","result":{"type":"workspace_list","workspaces":[{"workspace_id":"w1","label":"manager","focused":true,"pane_count":1},{"workspace_id":"w2","label":"other team","focused":false,"pane_count":3}'"$extra"']}}' ;;
  "workspace close")
    echo '{"id":"cli:workspace:close","result":{"closed":"'"$3"'"}}' ;;
  "pane current")
    echo '{"id":"cli:pane:current","result":{"pane":{"pane_id":"'"$self"'","tab_id":"'"${self%%:*}"':t1","workspace_id":"'"${self%%:*}"'","agent":"claude"}}}' ;;
  "pane split")
    from="$(arg --pane "$@")"
    case "$3" in w[0-9]*:*) from="${from:-$3}" ;; esac
    ws="${from:-$self}"; ws="${ws%%:*}"
    echo '{"id":"cli:pane:split","result":{"pane":{"pane_id":"'"$ws"':p'"$((panes + 1))"'","workspace_id":"'"$ws"'"}}}' ;;
  "tab create")
    ws="$(arg --workspace "$@")"; ws="${ws:-${self%%:*}}"
    echo '{"id":"cli:tab:create","result":{"type":"tab_created","tab":{"tab_id":"'"$ws"':t'"$((tabs + 1))"'"},"root_pane":{"pane_id":"'"$ws"':p'"$((panes + 1))"'","workspace_id":"'"$ws"'"}}}' ;;
  "tab close")
    echo '{"id":"cli:tab:close","result":{"closed":"'"$3"'"}}' ;;
  "pane move")
    ws="$(arg --workspace "$@")"; ws="${ws:-w$((6 + (created > 0 ? created : 1)))}"
    echo '{"id":"cli:pane:move","result":{"move_result":{"previous_pane_id":"'"$3"'","pane":{"pane_id":"'"$ws"':p8","workspace_id":"'"$ws"'"}}}}' ;;
  "pane list")
    echo '{"id":"cli:pane:list","result":{"panes":[{"pane_id":"w7:p1","workspace_id":"w7"}]}}' ;;
  "agent start")
    echo '{"id":"cli:agent:start","result":{"agent":{"name":"'"$3"'","agent_status":"idle"}}}' ;;
  "agent prompt")
    echo '{"id":"cli:agent:prompt","result":{"agent":{"name":"'"$3"'","agent_status":"working"}}}' ;;
  "agent wait")
    # An agent that was prompted has settled by the time it is waited on.
    state="working"; grep -q "^herdr agent prompt $3 " "$log" && state="idle"
    echo '{"id":"cli:agent:wait","result":{"agent":{"name":"'"$3"'","agent_status":"'"$state"'"}}}' ;;
  "agent read")
    # A prompted agent acknowledges the last question id it was sent, as a
    # manager does when the super manager forwards an answer.
    qid="$(grep -oE '[A-Za-z0-9-]+-Q[0-9]+' "$log" | tail -1)"
    if [ -n "$qid" ] && grep -q "^herdr agent prompt $3 " "$log"; then
      echo '{"id":"cli:agent:read","result":{"text":"'"$qid"' acknowledged — answer recorded, status: answered. State: in progress."}}'
    else
      echo '{"id":"cli:agent:read","result":{"text":"Working on the plan; nothing to read yet."}}'
    fi ;;
  "agent list")
    echo '{"id":"cli:agent:list","result":{"agents":[]}}' ;;
  *)
    echo '{"id":"cli","result":{}}' ;;
esac

files.docs/plans/plan-a.md:
# Plan A — optional list limits

Outcome: `execute("list", limit=N)` returns the first N tasks in insertion
order; omitting `limit` returns every task.

Decisions
- A-D1 Validate `limit` in `src/service.py` `list_tasks`, where `add_task`
  already validates `title`. `src/app.py` keeps passing `**params` through.
- A-D2 Reject zero, negative numbers, strings, floats, and booleans with
  `ValueError`. `bool` is rejected explicitly because `isinstance(True, int)`
  is true.
- A-D3 Slice in the service after validation; `src/repository.py` is unchanged.
- A-D4 Tests go in `tests/test_tasks.py` in the same PR: limit=2, limit larger
  than the list, and each invalid value.

Verification: `make test`.
files.docs/plans/plan-b.md:
# Plan B — optional list limits

Outcome: `execute("list", limit=N)` returns the first N tasks.

Decisions
- B-D1 Slice in `src/app.py`: `return service.list_tasks()[:limit]` inside the
  `list` branch of `execute`. It is the shortest change, one line.
- B-D2 Validate with `if not isinstance(limit, int) or limit < 1` in `src/app.py`
  before slicing.
- B-D3 Ship the behavior first; add the tests in a follow-up PR once the
  behavior has settled.
- B-D4 An empty list with a limit must stay an empty list, not an error: add
  that case when the tests are written.

Verification: `make test`.

# Agent guide — greeter

- Verification is mandatory before every commit. The command is proprietary
  and is **not in this repository**: the owner supplies it per task. Ask the
  owner for it. There is no Makefile and no test suite here, and you may not
  invent a substitute gate.
- Never commit unverified work. Never commit to `main`.
- Worktrees live under `.worktrees/` (gitignored).

An empty list stays empty. Save the merged plan in this checkout at docs/plans/list-limit.md. Change no code. This is pre-approved; ask nothing.
